reviews.review:
I bought this on a whim thinking it would be a cute and short game, and that's exactly what I got.

The store page says the game has point-and-click gameplay, and I don't think that's exactly correct. Basically, you can choose which deliveries to accept, and there's a small map with all the possible locations you can go to. If you pick a wrong location, you can just try again until you pick the right one. I don't think it's possible to lose or get a game over or even end the game without getting on a route (though regardless [spoiler]the story ends on your first date[/spoiler]).

In addition to that, you can use the money you earn to buy decorations to customize your bedroom. I didn't bother with this after the first playthrough (maybe that says something about me lol) but I enjoyed it for the first one at least.

The story itself is pure slice of life. Nothing bad really happens, although there's some bittersweetness from past events brought up. There are three love interests who all have pretty distinct personalities and designs. Rather than distinct routes, you proceed through each day getting occasional one-on-one events with them, and then a dedicated scene with a CG at the end. It's all pretty cute, especially for the price.

Also, don't press the H button.

[i]For more romance game recommendations, check out my curator, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/32080131/]Games for Hopeless Romantics[/url].[/i]
